req.title: 404 on unknown task id
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 and detail 'Task not found' when the id does not exist.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 404 with a specific detail message when GET /tasks/{task_id} is called with a non-existent ID. The violation was test[6] having kind=negative but heuristic=EP; negative tests must use heuristic=NEG. Fix: change that test's heuristic from EP to NEG. All other tests are preserved exactly. Coverage: (1) positive/EP confirms 200 for a valid ID; (2) negative/NEG confirms 404+detail for a clearly non-existent ID; (3) BVA lower boundary id=0; (4) BVA upper boundary id=21 (one above max seeded); (5) BVA max valid id=20 returns 200; (6) negative/NEG for deleted task yields 404; (7) negative/NEG for large sentinel id=999999 yields 404.

tests.name: test_get_existing_task_returns_200_not_404
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 20 tasks including id=1
expected: Response body contains id=1 and title='Read chapter 5'
trace: R-TASK-009: confirms the 404 path is NOT triggered for a valid ID, catching mutations that always return 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base
from app import models

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db

with TestingSessionLocal() as seed_db:
    seed_db.add(models.Task(id=1, title="Read chapter 5", description="desc", completed=True))
    seed_db.commit()

client = TestClient(app)

r = client.get("/tasks/1")
assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {r.status_code}"
body = r.json()
assert body["id"] == 1
assert body["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
assert body["completed"] == True

app.dependency_overrides.clear()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base
from app import models

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db

with TestingSessionLocal() as seed_db:
    seed_db.add(models.Task(id=5, title="Task 5", completed=False))
    seed_db.commit()

with TestingSessionLocal() as del_db:
    task = del_db.query(models.Task).filter(models.Task.id == 5).first()
    del_db.delete(task)
    del_db.commit()

client = TestClient(app)

r = client.get("/tasks/5")
assert r.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404 for deleted task, got {r.status_code}"
body = r.json()
assert "detail" in body
assert body["detail"] == "Task with id 5 not found", f"Unexpected detail: {body['detail']}"

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
